description: Lightbox Gallery Pro - Commercial License 1. Description of the offer: This subscription removes the "Trial / Free Version" watermark overlay from the image viewer. While the free version allows users to test all features (including Deep Zoom, Rotation, and Navigation), it displays a semi-transparent text over the images. The Pro plan unlocks the pristine, commercial version of the visual, ensuring a clean and unobstructed viewing experience without limiting any functionality. 2. Type of user that benefits from the offer: This plan is designed for Business Consultants, Auditors, Agencies, and Enterprise Teams who share reports with clients or executive stakeholders. It is intended for professionals who need to present their work without "Trial" labels or visual obstructions that compromise the quality of the presentation. 3. Customer need or pain that the offer addresses: It solves the need for professional presentation and visual clarity. During detailed inspections (e.g., retail audits, quality control, or insurance claims), an overlay watermark can be distracting or obscure critical details. This offer ensures that the image gallery looks native, polished, and trustworthy, removing the visual friction of a trial license.
